'''Xana Exotic Arms''' was a weapons manufacturer known for the [[MSW-9 Molecular Stiletto]].<ref name="GFT" /> The company's owners were hidden behind a series of false names, holding companies and shell corporations. Xana were the propriety owners of the design to [[monomolecular blade]]s, and did not license the technology or reveal the secret to creating the weapon.<ref name="AEG">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Specter of the Past]]'', Xana is mispelled as "Zana."
